# NES Mastery

> NES Mastery is Nepal's leading examination preparation platform specializing in competitive engineering and technical examinations.

## Core Examination Tracks

- **IOE Entrance Examination**: Preparation for Institute of Engineering (Tribhuvan University) B.E./B.Arch entrance exams with comprehensive physics, chemistry, mathematics, and English modules.
- **NEC License Examination**: Comprehensive mock questions and preparation for the Nepal Engineering Council professional engineer licensing exams across Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, and Computer disciplines.
- **Competitive Engineering & Technical Government Exams**: Full syllabus coverage for engineering posts and technical service examinations with authentic negative deduction scoring (-20%).

## Key Platform Features

- **Syllabus Explorer**: Official PSC and university syllabus tracking with hierarchical topic weightages and progress tracking.
- **Interactive Practice**: Real-time topic-wise MCQs with detailed explanations, reference citations, and instant grading.
- **Timed Mock Tests**: Authentic exam simulations strictly enforcing official time constraints and negative marking.
- **Study Materials**: Verified notes, revision summaries, and curriculum PDFs accessible on desktop and mobile devices.
